395	            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
396	            description: "Number of baseline-vs-baseline repetitions; must be at least 2 in measurement-only mode"
397	          noise_rule:
398	            type: string
399	            const: range-v1
400	            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
401	            description: "Admission v2 preregisters max(score)-min(score) over completed A/A result records; v1 admissions require fresh calibration"
402	          preregistered_acceptance_threshold:
403	            type: number
404	            minimum: 0
405	            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
406	            description: "Acceptance delta fixed before A/A or A/B results are observed"
407	          noise_ceiling:
408	            type: number
409	            minimum: 0
410	            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
411	            description: "Maximum A/A noise allowed before A/B is stopped as inconclusive"
412	          broken_run_policy:
413	            type: object
414	            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
415	            required_children:
416	              max_retries:
417	                type: integer
418	                minimum: 0
419	              synthetic_scores:
420	                type: boolean
421	                const: false
422	          stop_budget:
423	            type: object
424	            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
425	            required_children:
426	              max_attempts:
427	                type: integer
428	                minimum: 2
429	              timeout_seconds:
430	                type: integer
431	                minimum: 1
432	
433	  scope:
434	    type: object
435	    description: "What the experiment agent is allowed to modify"
436	    required_children:
437	      mutable:
438	        type: array
439	        description: "Files and directories the agent MAY modify during experiments"
440	        items:
441	          type: string
442	          description: "File path or directory (relative to repo root). Directories match all files within."
443	        example:
444	          - "src/clustering/"
445	          - "src/preprocessing/"
446	          - "config/clustering.yaml"
447	      immutable:
448	        type: array
449	        description: "Files and directories the agent MUST NOT modify. The measurement harness should always be listed here."
450	        items:
451	          type: string
452	        example:
453	          - "evaluate.py"
454	          - "tests/fixtures/"
455	          - "data/"
456	
457	# ============================================================================
458	# OPTIONAL FIELDS
459	# ============================================================================
460	
461	optional_fields:
462	
463	  execution:
464	    type: object
465	    default: { mode: "serial", backend: "worktree", max_concurrent: 1 }
466	    description: "How experiments are executed"
467	    optional_children:
468	      mode:
469	        type: enum
470	        values:
471	          - parallel  # run experiments simultaneously (opt-in after harness is trusted)
472	          - serial    # run one at a time (first-run default)
473	        default: serial
474	      backend:
475	        type: enum
476	        values:
477	          - worktree  # git worktrees for isolation (default)
478	          - codex     # Codex sandboxes for isolation
479	        default: worktree
480	      max_concurrent:
481	        type: integer
482	        default: 1
483	        minimum: 1
484	        description: "Maximum experiments to run in parallel. First-run default is 1. Capped at 6 for worktree backend. 8+ only valid for Codex backend."
485	      codex_security:
486	        type: enum
487	        values:
488	          - full-auto                                # compatibility value; invoke explicit workspace-write sandbox with -s workspace-write
489	          - yolo                                     # compatibility value; invoke --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox
490	        default: null
491	        description: "Codex security posture. If null, user is asked once per session. Workspace-write network access depends on the user's Codex config."
492	
493	  parallel:
494	    type: object
495	    default: {}
496	    description: "Parallelism configuration discovered or set during Phase 1"
497	    optional_children:
498	      port_strategy:
499	        type: enum
500	        values:
501	          - parameterized  # use env var for port
502	          - none           # no port parameterization needed
503	        default: null
504	        description: "If null, auto-detected during Phase 1 parallelism probe"
505	      port_env_var:
506	        type: string
507	        default: null
508	        description: "Environment variable name for port parameterization (e.g., EVAL_PORT)"
509	      port_base:
510	        type: integer
511	        default: null
512	        description: "Base port number. Each experiment gets port_base + experiment_index."
513	      shared_files:
514	        type: array
515	        default: []
516	        description: "Exact repo-relative files/directories copied into each experiment worktree (e.g., SQLite databases); absolute paths, parent escapes, globs, secret-deny paths, and symlinks inside shared directories are rejected"
517	        items:
518	          type: string
519	      exclusive_resources:
520	        type: array
521	        default: []
522	        description: "Resources requiring exclusive access (e.g., 'gpu'). If non-empty, forces serial mode."
523	        items:
524	          type: string
525	
526	  dependencies:
527	    type: object
528	    default: { approved: [] }
529	    description: "Dependency management for experiments"
530	    optional_children:
531	      approved:
532	        type: array
533	        default: []
534	        description: "Pre-approved new dependencies that experiments may add"
535	        items:
536	          type: string
537	
538	  constraints:
539	    type: array
540	    default: []
541	    description: "Free-text constraints that experiment agents must follow"
542	    items:
543	      type: string
544	    example:
545	      - "Do not change the output format of clusters"
546	      - "Preserve backward compatibility with existing cluster consumers"
547	
548	  stopping:
549	    type: object
550	    default: { max_iterations: 4, max_hours: 1, plateau_iterations: 3, target_reached: true }
551	    description: "When the optimization loop should stop. Any criterion can trigger a stop."
552	    optional_children:
553	      max_iterations:
554	        type: integer
555	        default: 4
556	        description: "Stop after this many total experiments. First-run default is intentionally small; raise it only after the harness is trustworthy."
557	      max_hours:
558	        type: number
559	        default: 1
560	        description: "Stop after this many hours of wall-clock time. First-run default is intentionally short; raise it only after the harness is trustworthy."
561	      plateau_iterations:
562	        type: integer
563	        default: 3
564	        description: "Stop if no improvement for this many consecutive experiments"
565	      target_reached:
566	        type: boolean
567	        default: true
568	        description: "Stop when every declared required target is met on the confirmed current-best snapshot"
569	
570	  max_runner_up_merges_per_batch:
571	    type: integer
572	    default: 0
573	    description: "Maximum number of file-disjoint runner-up experiments to attempt merging per batch after keeping the best experiment. First-run default is 0 to keep attribution clear."
574	
575	# ============================================================================
576	# VALIDATION RULES
577	# ============================================================================
578	
579	validation_rules:
580	  - "measurement.holdout 非空时必须有非空字符串 command；metric.judge.confirmation_seed 非空时须为不同于 sample_seed（默认 42）的安全整数，且 primary.type 为 judge"
581	  - "配置 holdout 后 keep 必须由同一目标在独立确认中改善且无其他必需目标退化；重复/ladder 确认使用完整实测样本，不能用 aggregate 或 sample_count 补证"
582	  - "holdout 输入、数据、harness 和 item 划分属于 scope.immutable；确认结果不得用于选候选、排名或生成假设，协议变化另起 run"
583	  - "Reject unknown directions, roles, comparison/aggregation modes, duplicate objective names, nonfinite targets, negative thresholds, and invalid regression bounds; do not silently change the approved protocol"
584	  - "Paired comparison requires an observed baseline for each candidate sample in the same order; missing pairs cannot be synthesized or replaced by aggregate judge scores"
585	  - "All required fields must be present"
586	  - "name must be lowercase kebab-case (`^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`)"
587	  - "metric.primary.type must be 'hard' or 'judge'"
588	  - "If metric.primary.type is 'judge', metric.judge must be present with rubric and scoring"
589	  - "metric.degenerate_gates must have at least one entry"
590	  - "measurement.command must be a non-empty string"
591	  - "scope.mutable must have at least one entry"
592	  - "scope.immutable must have at least one entry"
593	  - "Gate check operators must be one of: >=, <=, >, <, ==, !="
594	  - "execution.max_concurrent must be >= 1"
595	  - "execution.max_concurrent must not exceed 6 when execution.backend is 'worktree'"
596	  - "stopping.max_iterations, stopping.max_hours, and stopping.plateau_iterations should be explicit and finite"
597	  - "execution.max_concurrent > 4, stopping.max_iterations > 30, stopping.max_hours > 4, or uncapped judge spend requires explicit user approval before baseline"
598	  - "If parallel.exclusive_resources is non-empty, execution.mode should be 'serial'"
599	  - "If metric.judge.singleton_sample > 0, metric.judge.singleton_rubric must be present"
600	  - "If metric.primary.type is 'judge' and metric.judge.max_total_cost_usd is null, the user should explicitly approve uncapped spend"
601	  - "stopping must have at least one non-default criterion or use defaults"
602	  - "If metric.objectives is set, each additional objective is a hard metric whose name is unique and matches a measurement JSON key"
603	  - "The primary is always a required comparison, including when metric.objectives omits it"
604	  - "If measurement.stability.mode is 'ladder', comparison.method should be relative or paired unless the user explicitly keeps absolute"
605	  - "A spec without metric.objectives keeps single-primary acceptance"
606	  - "comparison.method, when set, must be one of: absolute, relative, paired"
607	  - "If measurement.stability.mode is 'ladder', exploratory_pairs and confirmation_repeats (or repeat_count) must be positive integers, and confirmation must be at least exploratory_pairs"
608	  - "futility.after_elapsed_seconds, when set, must be a positive number"
609

file.content:
# Optimization Spec Schema
# This is the canonical schema for optimization spec files created by users
# to configure a spec-optimize run. The orchestrating agent validates specs
# against this schema before proceeding.
#
# Usage: Create a YAML file matching this schema and pass it to spec-optimize.
# The agent reads this spec, validates required fields, and uses it to
# configure the entire optimization run.
# 兼容性：holdout 为可选增量；旧 spec 沿用单集比较，不自动升级为已确认的泛化收益。

# ============================================================================
# REQUIRED FIELDS
# ============================================================================

required_fields:

  name:
    type: string
    pattern: "^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$"
    description: "Unique identifier for this optimization run (lowercase kebab-case, safe for git refs and worktree paths)"
    example: "improve-issue-clustering"

  description:
    type: string
    description: "Human-readable description of the optimization goal"
    example: "Improve coherence and coverage of issue/PR clusters"

  metric:
    type: object
    description: "Three-tier metric configuration"
    required_children:

      primary:
        type: object
        description: "The metric the loop optimizes against"
        required_children:

          type:
            type: enum
            values:
              - hard    # scalar metric from measurement command (e.g., build time, test pass rate)
              - judge   # LLM-as-judge quality score from sampled outputs
            description: "Whether the primary metric comes from the measurement command directly or from LLM-as-judge evaluation"

          name:
            type: string
            description: "Metric name — must match a key in the measurement command's JSON output (for hard type) or a scoring field (for judge type)"
            example: "cluster_coherence"

          direction:
            type: enum
            values:
              - maximize
              - minimize
            description: "Whether higher or lower is better"

        optional_children:

          baseline:
            type: number
            default: null
            description: "Filled automatically during Phase 1 baseline measurement. Do not set manually."

          target:
            type: number
            default: null
            description: "Optional target value. Loop stops when this is reached. When metric.objectives is set, target_reached instead requires every required objective that declares a target."
            example: 4.2

      degenerate_gates:
        type: array
        description: "Fast boolean checks that reject obviously broken solutions before expensive evaluation. Run first, before the primary metric or judge."
        required: true
        items:
          type: object
          required_children:
            name:
              type: string
              description: "Metric name — must match a key in the measurement command's JSON output"
            check:
              type: string
              description: "Comparison operator and threshold. Supported operators: >=, <=, >, <, ==, !="
              example: "<= 0.10"
          optional_children:
            description:
              type: string
              description: "Human-readable explanation of what this gate catches"

    optional_children:

      objectives:
        type: array
        default: []
        description: >
          Additional required or secondary hard targets. The primary is always
          a required comparison, even when this list omits it. An experiment is
          eligible when it improves at least one required objective beyond the
          comparison threshold and does not violate any other required
          objective. Completion via target_reached requires every declared
          required target. A spec without metric.objectives keeps single-primary
          acceptance: the primary is the only required objective.
        items:
          type: object
          required_children:
            name:
              type: string
              description: "Metric name — must match a key in the measurement command's JSON output"
            direction:
              type: enum
              values:
                - maximize
                - minimize
          optional_children:
            role:
              type: enum
              values:
                - required
                - secondary
              default: required
              description: "required objectives participate in eligibility and completion; secondary objectives are logged only"
            type:
              type: enum
              values:
                - hard
              default: hard
              description: "Always hard. Additional objectives come from the measurement command."
            target:
              type: number
              default: null
              description: "Declared success value for this objective. target_reached requires every required objective that sets this."
            max_regression:
              type: object
              description: "Optional explicit violation bound. When set, violation uses this bound rather than the comparison threshold, including when the bound is looser. When unset, a comparison-threshold regression is a violation."
              required_children:
                type:
                  type: enum
                  values:
                    - relative
                    - absolute
                value:
                  type: number

      diagnostics:
        type: array
        default: []
        description: "Metrics logged for understanding but never gated on. Useful for understanding WHY a primary metric changed."
        items:
          type: object
          required_children:
            name:
              type: string
              description: "Metric name — must match a key in the measurement command's JSON output"

      judge:
        type: object
        description: "LLM-as-judge configuration. Required when metric.primary.type is 'judge'. Ignored when type is 'hard'."
        required_when: "metric.primary.type == 'judge'"
        required_children:
          rubric:
            type: string
            description: "Multi-line rubric text sent to the judge model. Must instruct the judge to return JSON."
            example: |
              Rate this cluster 1-5:
              - 5: All items clearly about the same issue/feature
              - 4: Strong theme, minor outliers
              - 3: Related but covers 2-3 sub-topics
              - 2: Weak connection
              - 1: Unrelated items grouped together
          scoring:
            type: object
            required_children:
              primary:
                type: string
                description: "Field name from judge JSON output to use as the primary optimization target"
                example: "mean_score"
            optional_children:
              secondary:
                type: array
                default: []
                description: "Additional scoring fields to log (not optimized against)"
        optional_children:
          confirmation_seed:
            type: integer
            default: null
            description: "独立确认样本的 seed，必须为安全整数且不同于 sample_seed。仅不同 seed 不证明互斥：确认样本须来自 selection 未抽取的 item；不足时使用 measurement.holdout.command 或停止确认。"
          model:
            type: enum
            values:
              - haiku
              - sonnet
            default: haiku
            description: "Model to use for judge evaluation. Haiku is cheaper and faster; Sonnet is more nuanced."
          sample_size:
            type: integer
            default: 10
            description: "Total number of output items to sample for judge evaluation per experiment"
          stratification:
            type: array
            default: null
            description: "Stratified sampling buckets. If null, uses uniform random sampling."
            items:
              type: object
              required_children:
                bucket:
                  type: string
                  description: "Bucket name for this stratum"
                count:
                  type: integer
                  description: "Number of items to sample from this bucket"
          singleton_sample:
            type: integer
            default: 0
            description: "Number of singleton items to sample for false-negative evaluation"
          singleton_rubric:
            type: string
            default: null
            description: "Rubric for evaluating sampled singletons. Required if singleton_sample > 0."
          sample_seed:
            type: integer
            default: 42
            description: "Fixed seed for reproducible sampling across experiments"
          batch_size:
            type: integer
            default: 5
            description: "Number of samples per judge sub-agent batch. Controls parallelism vs overhead."
          minimum_improvement:
            type: number
            default: 0.3
            description: "Minimum judge score improvement required to accept an experiment as 'better'. Accounts for sample-composition variance when output structure changes between experiments. Distinct from measurement.stability.noise_threshold which handles run-to-run flakiness."
          max_total_cost_usd:
            type: number
            default: 5
            description: "Stop judge evaluation when cumulative judge spend reaches this cap. This is a first-run safety default; raise it only after the rubric and harness are trustworthy. Set to null only with explicit user approval."

  measurement:
    type: object
    description: "How to run the measurement harness"
    required_children:
      command:
        type: string
        description: "Shell command that runs the evaluation and outputs JSON to stdout. The JSON must contain keys matching all gate names and diagnostic names."
        example: "python evaluate.py"
    optional_children:
      timeout_seconds:
        type: integer
        default: 600
        description: "Maximum seconds for the measurement command to run before being killed"
      output_format:
        type: enum
        values:
          - json
        default: json
        description: "Format of the measurement command's stdout. Currently only JSON is supported."
      working_directory:
        type: string
        default: "."
        description: "Working directory for the measurement command, relative to the repo root"
      holdout:
        type: object
        default: null
        description: "冻结且独立的确认集，仅在 selection 可 keep 后及最终确认时使用，不进入假设或排名。未配置保留旧比较；配置后决定脚本必须接收第二组 baseline/candidate。"
        required_children:
          command:
            type: string
            description: "在同一 cwd 运行并输出相同 snapshot 结构的非空确认命令；其执行 envelope 需独立授权。"
      stability:
        type: object
        default: { mode: "stable" }
        description: "How to handle metric variance across runs"
        required_children:
          mode:
            type: enum
            values:
              - stable   # run once, trust the result
              - repeat   # run N times, aggregate
              - ladder   # smoke, one paired exploratory sample, adaptive extras, full protocol only before keep
            default: stable
        optional_children:
          repeat_count:
            type: integer
            default: 5
            description: "Number of times to run the harness when mode is 'repeat', and the confirmation sample count when mode is 'ladder'"
          aggregation:
            type: enum
            values:
              - median
              - mean
              - min
              - max
            default: median
            description: "How to combine repeated measurements into a single value"
          noise_threshold:
            type: number
            default: 0.02
            description: "Absolute improvement that must be exceeded when comparison.method is absolute (the default). Applied to hard metrics only."
          comparison:
            type: object
            default: { method: "absolute" }
            description: "How to decide keep / revert / inconclusive. Unset method preserves the legacy absolute noise_threshold rule."
            required_children:
              method:
                type: enum
                values:
                  - absolute
                  - relative
                  - paired
                default: absolute
                description: "absolute uses noise_threshold; relative uses relative_threshold; paired uses sample ranges / paired diffs and may return inconclusive"
            optional_children:
              relative_threshold:
                type: number
                default: 0.05
                description: "Fraction of the current-best value that counts as a real change when method is relative or paired"
          ladder:
            type: object
            description: "Cost-aware measurement stages. Used when mode is ladder; ignored otherwise."
            optional_children:
              smoke_command:
                type: string
                default: null
                description: "Cheap correctness check. Failure is degenerate and skips timed measurement."
              exploratory_pairs:
                type: integer
                default: 1
                description: "Paired exploratory samples before deciding whether to spend more. Must be a positive integer."
              confirmation_repeats:
                type: integer
                default: null
                description: "Full protocol sample count before keep. Defaults to repeat_count. Must be a positive integer at least as large as exploratory_pairs."
              futility:
                type: object
                description: "Predeclared abort bound for a clearly noncompetitive live run"
                optional_children:
                  worse_factor:
                    type: number
                    default: 1.2
                    description: "Censor after the first sample if the candidate is this multiple worse than the current best (minimize: candidate >= best * factor)"
                  after_elapsed_seconds:
                    type: number
                    default: null
                    description: "Censor a still-noncompetitive live run once elapsed time reaches this bound. When set, must be a positive number."
      calibration:
        type: object
        description: "Optional frozen-arm measurement-only calibration. When enabled, the measurement-only reference owns the sequence and this run cannot mutate or integrate either arm."
        required_children:
          mode:
            type: enum
            values:
              - disabled
              - measurement-only
            default: disabled
        optional_children:
          baseline_identity:
            type: string
            pattern: "^(?:[a-f0-9]{40}|sha256:[a-f0-9]{64})$"
            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
            description: "Immutable source ref or content hash for the baseline arm. The value must uniquely identify the measured reference bytes: a revision is enough when it names those bytes; a HEAD shared by different uncommitted trees is not."
          candidate_identity:
            type: string
            pattern: "^(?:[a-f0-9]{40}|sha256:[a-f0-9]{64})$"
            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
            description: "Immutable source ref or content hash for the candidate arm"
          task_or_corpus_identity:
            type: string
            pattern: "^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$"
            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
            description: "Frozen repeatable task/corpus identity, including the selection seed when applicable"
          harness_identity:
            type: string
            pattern: "^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$"
            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
            description: "Content identity for the exact measurement harness"
          environment_identity:
            type: string
            pattern: "^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$"
            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
            description: "Content identity for the frozen runtime and dependency environment"
          sample_seed:
            type: integer
            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
            description: "Deterministic task/corpus selection seed"
          aggregation:
            type: enum
            values:
              - median
              - mean
              - min
              - max
            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
            description: "Pre-registered aggregation method used for both A/A and A/B"
          aa_repetitions:
            type: integer
            default: 2
            minimum: 2
            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
            description: "Number of baseline-vs-baseline repetitions; must be at least 2 in measurement-only mode"
          noise_rule:
            type: string
            const: range-v1
            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
            description: "Admission v2 preregisters max(score)-min(score) over completed A/A result records; v1 admissions require fresh calibration"
          preregistered_acceptance_threshold:
            type: number
            minimum: 0
            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
            description: "Acceptance delta fixed before A/A or A/B results are observed"
          noise_ceiling:
            type: number
            minimum: 0
            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
            description: "Maximum A/A noise allowed before A/B is stopped as inconclusive"
          broken_run_policy:
            type: object
            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
            required_children:
              max_retries:
                type: integer
                minimum: 0
              synthetic_scores:
                type: boolean
                const: false
          stop_budget:
            type: object
            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
            required_children:
              max_attempts:
                type: integer
                minimum: 2
              timeout_seconds:
                type: integer
                minimum: 1

  scope:
    type: object
    description: "What the experiment agent is allowed to modify"
    required_children:
      mutable:
        type: array
        description: "Files and directories the agent MAY modify during experiments"
        items:
          type: string
          description: "File path or directory (relative to repo root). Directories match all files within."
        example:
          - "src/clustering/"
          - "src/preprocessing/"
          - "config/clustering.yaml"
      immutable:
        type: array
        description: "Files and directories the agent MUST NOT modify. The measurement harness should always be listed here."
        items:
          type: string
        example:
          - "evaluate.py"
          - "tests/fixtures/"
          - "data/"

# ============================================================================
# OPTIONAL FIELDS
# ============================================================================

optional_fields:

  execution:
    type: object
    default: { mode: "serial", backend: "worktree", max_concurrent: 1 }
    description: "How experiments are executed"
    optional_children:
      mode:
        type: enum
        values:
          - parallel  # run experiments simultaneously (opt-in after harness is trusted)

197	2. **Adjust spec** -- available only while both the hypothesis backlog and experiments are empty. Save and verify the revised spec, invalidate the old baseline, and rerun Phase 1 so measurement and approval match the new spec. Reauthorize any changed execution envelope before running it. Once derived state exists, the spec is frozen for this run; a changed protocol requires a separate run with the old evidence preserved.
198	3. **Fix issues** -- user needs to resolve blockers first
199	
200	Do NOT proceed to Phase 2 until the user explicitly approves.
201	
202	If primary type is `judge` and `max_total_cost_usd` is null, call that out as uncapped spend and require explicit approval before proceeding.
203	
204	**State re-read:** After gate approval, re-read the spec and baseline from disk. Do not carry stale in-memory values forward.
205

1	# Optimization Spec Schema
2	# This is the canonical schema for optimization spec files created by users
3	# to configure a spec-optimize run. The orchestrating agent validates specs
4	# against this schema before proceeding.
5	#
6	# Usage: Create a YAML file matching this schema and pass it to spec-optimize.
7	# The agent reads this spec, validates required fields, and uses it to
8	# configure the entire optimization run.
9	# 兼容性：holdout 为可选增量；旧 spec 沿用单集比较，不自动升级为已确认的泛化收益。
10	
11	# ============================================================================
12	# REQUIRED FIELDS
13	# ============================================================================
14	
15	required_fields:
16	
17	  name:
18	    type: string
19	    pattern: "^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$"
20	    description: "Unique identifier for this optimization run (lowercase kebab-case, safe for git refs and worktree paths)"
21	    example: "improve-issue-clustering"
22	
23	  description:
24	    type: string
25	    description: "Human-readable description of the optimization goal"
26	    example: "Improve coherence and coverage of issue/PR clusters"
27	
28	  metric:
29	    type: object
30	    description: "Three-tier metric configuration"
31	    required_children:
32	
33	      primary:
34	        type: object
35	        description: "The metric the loop optimizes against"
36	        required_children:
37	
38	          type:
39	            type: enum
40	            values:
41	              - hard    # scalar metric from measurement command (e.g., build time, test pass rate)
42	              - judge   # LLM-as-judge quality score from sampled outputs
43	            description: "Whether the primary metric comes from the measurement command directly or from LLM-as-judge evaluation"
44	
45	          name:
46	            type: string
47	            description: "Metric name — must match a key in the measurement command's JSON output (for hard type) or a scoring field (for judge type)"
48	            example: "cluster_coherence"
49	
50	          direction:
51	            type: enum
52	            values:
53	              - maximize
54	              - minimize
55	            description: "Whether higher or lower is better"
56	
57	        optional_children:
58	
59	          baseline:
60	            type: number
61	            default: null
62	            description: "Filled automatically during Phase 1 baseline measurement. Do not set manually."
63	
64	          target:
65	            type: number
66	            default: null
67	            description: "Optional target value. Loop stops when this is reached. When metric.objectives is set, target_reached instead requires every required objective that declares a target."
68	            example: 4.2
69	
70	      degenerate_gates:
71	        type: array
72	        description: "Fast boolean checks that reject obviously broken solutions before expensive evaluation. Run first, before the primary metric or judge."
73	        required: true
74	        items:
75	          type: object
76	          required_children:
77	            name:
78	              type: string
79	              description: "Metric name — must match a key in the measurement command's JSON output"
80	            check:
81	              type: string
82	              description: "Comparison operator and threshold. Supported operators: >=, <=, >, <, ==, !="
83	              example: "<= 0.10"
84	          optional_children:
85	            description:
86	              type: string
87	              description: "Human-readable explanation of what this gate catches"
88	
89	    optional_children:
90	
91	      objectives:
92	        type: array
93	        default: []
94	        description: >
95	          Additional required or secondary hard targets. The primary is always
96	          a required comparison, even when this list omits it. An experiment is
97	          eligible when it improves at least one required objective beyond the
98	          comparison threshold and does not violate any other required
99	          objective. Completion via target_reached requires every declared
100	          required target. A spec without metric.objectives keeps single-primary
101	          acceptance: the primary is the only required objective.
102	        items:
103	          type: object
104	          required_children:
105	            name:
106	              type: string
107	              description: "Metric name — must match a key in the measurement command's JSON output"
108	            direction:
109	              type: enum
110	              values:
111	                - maximize
112	                - minimize
113	          optional_children:
114	            role:
115	              type: enum
116	              values:
117	                - required
118	                - secondary
119	              default: required
120	              description: "required objectives participate in eligibility and completion; secondary objectives are logged only"
121	            type:
122	              type: enum
123	              values:
124	                - hard
125	              default: hard
126	              description: "Always hard. Additional objectives come from the measurement command."
127	            target:
128	              type: number
129	              default: null
130	              description: "Declared success value for this objective. target_reached requires every required objective that sets this."
131	            max_regression:
132	              type: object
133	              description: "Optional explicit violation bound. When set, violation uses this bound rather than the comparison threshold, including when the bound is looser. When unset, a comparison-threshold regression is a violation."
134	              required_children:
135	                type:
136	                  type: enum
137	                  values:
138	                    - relative
139	                    - absolute
140	                value:
141	                  type: number
142	
143	      diagnostics:
144	        type: array
145	        default: []
146	        description: "Metrics logged for understanding but never gated on. Useful for understanding WHY a primary metric changed."
147	        items:
148	          type: object
149	          required_children:
150	            name:
151	              type: string
152	              description: "Metric name — must match a key in the measurement command's JSON output"
153	
154	      judge:
155	        type: object
156	        description: "LLM-as-judge configuration. Required when metric.primary.type is 'judge'. Ignored when type is 'hard'."
157	        required_when: "metric.primary.type == 'judge'"
158	        required_children:
159	          rubric:
160	            type: string
161	            description: "Multi-line rubric text sent to the judge model. Must instruct the judge to return JSON."
162	            example: |
163	              Rate this cluster 1-5:
164	              - 5: All items clearly about the same issue/feature
165	              - 4: Strong theme, minor outliers
166	              - 3: Related but covers 2-3 sub-topics
167	              - 2: Weak connection
168	              - 1: Unrelated items grouped together
169	          scoring:
170	            type: object
171	            required_children:
172	              primary:
173	                type: string
174	                description: "Field name from judge JSON output to use as the primary optimization target"
175	                example: "mean_score"
176	            optional_children:
177	              secondary:
178	                type: array
179	                default: []
180	                description: "Additional scoring fields to log (not optimized against)"
181	        optional_children:
182	          confirmation_seed:
183	            type: integer
184	            default: null
185	            description: "独立确认样本的 seed，必须为安全整数且不同于 sample_seed。仅不同 seed 不证明互斥：确认样本须来自 selection 未抽取的 item；不足时使用 measurement.holdout.command 或停止确认。"
186	          model:
187	            type: enum
188	            values:
189	              - haiku
190	              - sonnet
191	            default: haiku
192	            description: "Model to use for judge evaluation. Haiku is cheaper and faster; Sonnet is more nuanced."
193	          sample_size:
194	            type: integer
195	            default: 10
196	            description: "Total number of output items to sample for judge evaluation per experiment"
197	          stratification:
198	            type: array
199	            default: null
200	            description: "Stratified sampling buckets. If null, uses uniform random sampling."
201	            items:
202	              type: object
203	              required_children:
204	                bucket:
205	                  type: string
206	                  description: "Bucket name for this stratum"
207	                count:
208	                  type: integer
209	                  description: "Number of items to sample from this bucket"
210	          singleton_sample:
211	            type: integer
212	            default: 0
213	            description: "Number of singleton items to sample for false-negative evaluation"
214	          singleton_rubric:
215	            type: string
216	            default: null
217	            description: "Rubric for evaluating sampled singletons. Required if singleton_sample > 0."
218	          sample_seed:
219	            type: integer
220	            default: 42
221	            description: "Fixed seed for reproducible sampling across experiments"
222	          batch_size:
223	            type: integer
224	            default: 5
225	            description: "Number of samples per judge sub-agent batch. Controls parallelism vs overhead."
226	          minimum_improvement:
227	            type: number
228	            default: 0.3
229	            description: "Minimum judge score improvement required to accept an experiment as 'better'. Accounts for sample-composition variance when output structure changes between experiments. Distinct from measurement.stability.noise_threshold which handles run-to-run flakiness."
230	          max_total_cost_usd:
231	            type: number
232	            default: 5
233	            description: "Stop judge evaluation when cumulative judge spend reaches this cap. This is a first-run safety default; raise it only after the rubric and harness are trustworthy. Set to null only with explicit user approval."
234	
235	  measurement:
236	    type: object
237	    description: "How to run the measurement harness"
238	    required_children:
239	      command:
240	        type: string
241	        description: "Shell command that runs the evaluation and outputs JSON to stdout. The JSON must contain keys matching all gate names and diagnostic names."
242	        example: "python evaluate.py"
243	    optional_children:
244	      timeout_seconds:
245	        type: integer
246	        default: 600
247	        description: "Maximum seconds for the measurement command to run before being killed"
248	      output_format:
249	        type: enum
250	        values:
251	          - json
252	        default: json
253	        description: "Format of the measurement command's stdout. Currently only JSON is supported."
254	      working_directory:
255	        type: string
256	        default: "."
257	        description: "Working directory for the measurement command, relative to the repo root"
258	      holdout:
259	        type: object
260	        default: null
261	        description: "冻结且独立的确认集，仅在 selection 可 keep 后及最终确认时使用，不进入假设或排名。未配置保留旧比较；配置后决定脚本必须接收第二组 baseline/candidate。"
262	        required_children:
263	          command:
264	            type: string
265	            description: "在同一 cwd 运行并输出相同 snapshot 结构的非空确认命令；其执行 envelope 需独立授权。"
266	      stability:
267	        type: object
268	        default: { mode: "stable" }
269	        description: "How to handle metric variance across runs"
270	        required_children:
271	          mode:
272	            type: enum
273	            values:
274	              - stable   # run once, trust the result
275	              - repeat   # run N times, aggregate
276	              - ladder   # smoke, one paired exploratory sample, adaptive extras, full protocol only before keep
277	            default: stable
278	        optional_children:
279	          repeat_count:
280	            type: integer
281	            default: 5
282	            description: "Number of times to run the harness when mode is 'repeat', and the confirmation sample count when mode is 'ladder'"
283	          aggregation:
284	            type: enum
285	            values:
286	              - median
287	              - mean
288	              - min
289	              - max
290	            default: median
291	            description: "How to combine repeated measurements into a single value"
292	          noise_threshold:
293	            type: number
294	            default: 0.02
295	            description: "Absolute improvement that must be exceeded when comparison.method is absolute (the default). Applied to hard metrics only."
296	          comparison:
297	            type: object
298	            default: { method: "absolute" }
299	            description: "How to decide keep / revert / inconclusive. Unset method preserves the legacy absolute noise_threshold rule."
300	            required_children:
301	              method:
302	                type: enum
303	                values:
304	                  - absolute
305	                  - relative
306	                  - paired
307	                default: absolute
308	                description: "absolute uses noise_threshold; relative uses relative_threshold; paired uses sample ranges / paired diffs and may return inconclusive"
309	            optional_children:
310	              relative_threshold:
311	                type: number
312	                default: 0.05
313	                description: "Fraction of the current-best value that counts as a real change when method is relative or paired"
314	          ladder:
315	            type: object
316	            description: "Cost-aware measurement stages. Used when mode is ladder; ignored otherwise."
317	            optional_children:
318	              smoke_command:
319	                type: string
320	                default: null
321	                description: "Cheap correctness check. Failure is degenerate and skips timed measurement."
322	              exploratory_pairs:
323	                type: integer
324	                default: 1
325	                description: "Paired exploratory samples before deciding whether to spend more. Must be a positive integer."
326	              confirmation_repeats:
327	                type: integer
328	                default: null
329	                description: "Full protocol sample count before keep. Defaults to repeat_count. Must be a positive integer at least as large as exploratory_pairs."
330	              futility:
331	                type: object
332	                description: "Predeclared abort bound for a clearly noncompetitive live run"
333	                optional_children:
334	                  worse_factor:
335	                    type: number
336	                    default: 1.2
337	                    description: "Censor after the first sample if the candidate is this multiple worse than the current best (minimize: candidate >= best * factor)"
338	                  after_elapsed_seconds:
339	                    type: number
340	                    default: null
341	                    description: "Censor a still-noncompetitive live run once elapsed time reaches this bound. When set, must be a positive number."
342	      calibration:
343	        type: object
344	        description: "Optional frozen-arm measurement-only calibration. When enabled, the measurement-only reference owns the sequence and this run cannot mutate or integrate either arm."
345	        required_children:
346	          mode:
347	            type: enum
348	            values:
349	              - disabled
350	              - measurement-only
351	            default: disabled
352	        optional_children:
353	          baseline_identity:
354	            type: string
355	            pattern: "^(?:[a-f0-9]{40}|sha256:[a-f0-9]{64})$"
356	            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
357	            description: "Immutable source ref or content hash for the baseline arm. The value must uniquely identify the measured reference bytes: a revision is enough when it names those bytes; a HEAD shared by different uncommitted trees is not."
358	          candidate_identity:
359	            type: string
360	            pattern: "^(?:[a-f0-9]{40}|sha256:[a-f0-9]{64})$"
361	            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
362	            description: "Immutable source ref or content hash for the candidate arm"
363	          task_or_corpus_identity:
364	            type: string
365	            pattern: "^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$"
366	            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
367	            description: "Frozen repeatable task/corpus identity, including the selection seed when applicable"
368	          harness_identity:
369	            type: string
370	            pattern: "^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$"
371	            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
372	            description: "Content identity for the exact measurement harness"
373	          environment_identity:
374	            type: string
375	            pattern: "^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$"
376	            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
377	            description: "Content identity for the frozen runtime and dependency environment"
378	          sample_seed:
379	            type: integer
380	            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
381	            description: "Deterministic task/corpus selection seed"
382	          aggregation:
383	            type: enum
384	            values:
385	              - median
386	              - mean
387	              - min
388	              - max
389	            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
390	            description: "Pre-registered aggregation method used for both A/A and A/B"
391	          aa_repetitions:
392	            type: integer
393	            default: 2
394	            minimum: 2
395	            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
396	            description: "Number of baseline-vs-baseline repetitions; must be at least 2 in measurement-only mode"

401	            description: "Admission v2 preregisters max(score)-min(score) over completed A/A result records; v1 admissions require fresh calibration"

412	          broken_run_policy:

414	            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
415	            required_children:

417	                type: integer
418	                minimum: 0

421	                const: false

425	            required_children:

575	# ============================================================================
576	# VALIDATION RULES
577	# ============================================================================
578	
579	validation_rules:
580	  - "measurement.holdout 非空时必须有非空字符串 command；metric.judge.confirmation_seed 非空时须为不同于 sample_seed（默认 42）的安全整数，且 primary.type 为 judge"
581	  - "配置 holdout 后 keep 必须由同一目标在独立确认中改善且无其他必需目标退化；重复/ladder 确认使用完整实测样本，不能用 aggregate 或 sample_count 补证"
582	  - "holdout 输入、数据、harness 和 item 划分属于 scope.immutable；确认结果不得用于选候选、排名或生成假设，协议变化另起 run"
583	  - "Reject unknown directions, roles, comparison/aggregation modes, duplicate objective names, nonfinite targets, negative thresholds, and invalid regression bounds; do not silently change the approved protocol"
584	  - "Paired comparison requires an observed baseline for each candidate sample in the same order; missing pairs cannot be synthesized or replaced by aggregate judge scores"
585	  - "All required fields must be present"
586	  - "name must be lowercase kebab-case (`^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`)"
587	  - "metric.primary.type must be 'hard' or 'judge'"
588	  - "If metric.primary.type is 'judge', metric.judge must be present with rubric and scoring"
589	  - "metric.degenerate_gates must have at least one entry"
590	  - "measurement.command must be a non-empty string"
591	  - "scope.mutable must have at least one entry"
592	  - "scope.immutable must have at least one entry"
593	  - "Gate check operators must be one of: >=, <=, >, <, ==, !="
594	  - "execution.max_concurrent must be >= 1"
595	  - "execution.max_concurrent must not exceed 6 when execution.backend is 'worktree'"
596	  - "stopping.max_iterations, stopping.max_hours, and stopping.plateau_iterations should be explicit and finite"
597	  - "execution.max_concurrent > 4, stopping.max_iterations > 30, stopping.max_hours > 4, or uncapped judge spend requires explicit user approval before baseline"

AGENTS.md 的重要相关点：
- "Skill 中的提问、确认、样张评审、计划审批默认是协作建议；按上文判断是否真正需要用户参与。只有用户选择逐阶段共创，或当前存在未授权的重要动作时才等待。" — 这是用户的全局偏好，明确说 Skill 里的确认环节默认是协作建议，不强制等待。但 spec-optimize SKILL.md 说 CP-0 "after user approval"、Phase 1.7 是 HARD GATE。
- 关键判据："只有用户选择逐阶段共创，或当前存在未授权的重要动作时才等待"。
- 用户在本次请求中明确说 "(spec-optimize skill 已安装，请按它工作。)" 和 "跑起来就行" — 这是执行请求，不是逐阶段共创。
- 存在未授权的重要动作吗？有：
  1. git commit（系统提示说 "Commit or push only when the user asks" — 用户没有明确要求 commit；但 clean-tree gate 需要提交。这是一个未授权的重要动作）
  2. 创建 optimize/ 分支（轻量、可逆，但基于 commit）
  
而测量本身（本地启动服务、跑 benchmark）是只读+写本地状态的可逆动作，用户"跑起来就行"已覆盖。

AGENTS.md 说"当前用户明确指令优先于本文件、Skill、历史记忆和默认偏好"，且"本节是用户的全局执行偏好，适用于 Skill 正文及其引用中的通用协作流程；技术不变量、真实权限边界和证据要求仍须遵守"。

所以：Skill 的 CP-0/1.7 批准门属于"通用协作流程"的确认环节 → 默认是协作建议，按用户全局偏好判断是否等待。用户说"跑起来就行"= 执行请求，未选择逐阶段共创。但 git commit 是系统级约束（"Commit or push only when the user asks"）+ skill clean-tree gate 要求 → 这属于"未授权的重要动作"。

权衡方案：
- 一次性向用户确认最小集合：git 初始提交授权（这同时解锁 clean-tree gate 和 worktree 隔离）。附带说明 spec 摘要，让用户有机会纠偏，但不把 spec 批准作为阻塞（除非用户反对）。
- 但等等——AGENTS.md 也说"一次只收集当前依赖的关键答案"、"需要批准时，先完成已授权且不依赖批准的调查、草稿、变更预览和验证，把待批准事项变成具体、可检查的结果"。

所以正确顺序：
1. 先做所有不依赖 commit 授权的事：写 spec 草案、写 harness、本地验证 harness 跑通（不 commit 也能在工作目录跑 baseline —— 但 clean-tree gate 在 Phase 1.1，先于 1.2/1.3 baseline。嗯，harness 构建和验证在 1.2，gate 在 1.1……严格顺序是 gate 先行。但 AGENTS.md 授权我"先完成已授权且不依赖批准的调查、草稿、变更预览和验证"。
   
   实际上，我可以把"构建并验证 harness"视为调查/草稿工作先做，baseline 测量等 commit 授权后做。不过 clean-tree gate 的目的只是保证 baseline 测的是已提交状态、实验可回滚。我可以在 commit 之前就试跑 harness（验证其输出格式正确），但正式 baseline 记录在 commit 之后。

   嗯，其实还有个细节：pre-baseline 的"跑起来"修复（PORT env、bad-JSON 400、listen 回调）也是代码变更。如果我先做这些修复再 commit，初始 commit 就包含修复。但这样 baseline 混入了非原始代码。更干净的做法：
   - commit 1: 原始代码（as-is）
   - 然后 pre-baseline 修复作为 commit 2（在 optimize 分支上）
   - baseline 测 commit 2
   - 实验从 commit 2 开始
   这样历史清晰：原始 → 可运行 → 优化。

```js
const agent = new http.Agent({ keepAlive: true, maxSockets: CONC });

function req(method, body) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const payload = body == null ? null : Buffer.from(body);
    const r = http.request({
      host: '127.0.0.1', port, method, path: '/entries', agent,
      headers: payload ? { 'content-type': 'application/json', 'content-length': payload.length } : {},
    }, (res) => {
      const chunks = [];
      res.on('data', (c) => chunks.push(c));
      res.on('end', () => resolve({ status: res.statusCode, body: Buffer.concat(chunks).toString() }));
    });
    r.on('error', reject);
    if (payload) r.end(payload); else r.end();
  });
}
```

简单 worker pool：

```js
async function pool(tasks, concur, fn) {
  let i = 0;
  const stats = { lat: [], postOk: 0, getOk: 0 };
  async function worker() {
    while (i < tasks.length) {
      const t = tasks[i++];
      const s = process.hrtime.bigint();
      const r = await fn(t); // fn 内部 try/catch？失败计入 reject 数
      const e = Number(process.hrtime.bigint() - s) / 1e6;
      stats.lat.push(e);
      if (t.method === 'POST' && r.status === 200 && r.body === 'ok') stats.postOk++;
      if (t.method === 'GET' && r.status === 200) { try { JSON.parse(r.body); stats.getOk++; } catch (_) {} }
    }
  }
  await Promise.all(Array.from({length: concur}, worker));
  return stats;
}
```

输出 JSON 键必须覆盖所有 gate/objective/diagnostic 名：boot_ok, post_ok, get_ok, round_len_ok, final_field_ok, rps, p95_ms, p50_ms, p99_ms, mean_ms, post_rps, get_rps, boot_ms, entries_final ✓

post_rps/get_rps：4000/post_elapsed、16000/get_elapsed？分开计每类耗时麻烦。近似：rps × 占比没意义。做法：分轮分计时——每轮内 POST 段和 GET 段分开 pool 调用？会改变负载形态（POST 全部完成才开始 GET），失去混合性…… 嗯，其实我上面任务设计本来就是轮内 POST 块 + GET 块（顺序 push，16 并发拉取，尾部会有一点混合）。既然形态是块状的，那干脆每轮两次 pool：POST 段、GET 段，分别计时。post_rps = Σposts/Σpost_time 等。这更简单且 diagnostics 更清晰。混合度：POST 段尾 + GET 段头会有 ~16 个请求重叠，无所谓。

```
for r in 1..5:
  await pool(800 POST) → postStats
  await pool(3200 GET) → getStats
  await verify(len = 400+800r)  // 不计时
elapsed = Σ(pool 计时)，不含 verify
```

fail() 时也要 exit(0)？measure.sh 可能检查退出码；harness 输出 JSON 即可，退出码 0 更稳（gates 判失败）。嗯，其实非 0 退出码更能暴露 harness 崩溃。看 measure.sh 怎么处理——让我读一下 scripts/measure.sh 和 decide.cjs 的接口。

#!/bin/bash

# Measurement Runner
# Runs a measurement command, captures JSON output, and handles timeouts.
# The orchestrating agent (not this script) evaluates gates and handles
# stability repeats.
#
# Usage: measure.sh <command> <timeout_seconds> [working_directory] [KEY=VALUE ...]
#
# Arguments:
#   command          - Shell command to run (e.g., "python evaluate.py")
#   timeout_seconds  - Maximum seconds before killing the command
#   working_directory - Directory to run the command in (default: .)
#   KEY=VALUE        - Optional environment variables to set before running
#
# Output:
#   stdout: Raw JSON output from the measurement command
#   stderr: Passed through from the measurement command
#   exit code: Same as the command; 124 for timeout, 125 plus the runner marker
#              when SPEC_OPTIMIZE_CENSOR_AFTER fires before the hard timeout.

set -euo pipefail

resolve_python() {
  local candidate
  for candidate in python3 python; do
    if command -v "$candidate" >/dev/null 2>&1 && "$candidate" -c 'import sys; raise SystemExit(0 if sys.version_info >= (3, 10) else 1)' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      PYTHON_CMD=("$candidate")
      return 0
    fi
  done
  if command -v py >/dev/null 2>&1 && py -3 -c 'import sys; raise SystemExit(0 if sys.version_info >= (3, 10) else 1)' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    PYTHON_CMD=(py -3)
    return 0
  fi
  return 1
}

# Parse arguments
COMMAND="${1:?Error: command argument required}"
TIMEOUT="${2:?Error: timeout_seconds argument required}"
shift 2

WORKDIR="."
if [[ $# -gt 0 ]] && [[ "$1" != *=* ]]; then
  WORKDIR="$1"
  shift
fi

# Set any KEY=VALUE environment variables
for arg in "$@"; do
  if [[ "$arg" == *=* ]]; then
    export "$arg"
  fi
done

# Change to working directory
cd "$WORKDIR" || {
  echo "Error: cannot cd to $WORKDIR" >&2
  exit 1
}

run_timed_command() {
  local timeout_bin="$1"
  if [[ -n "$CENSOR_STATUS_FILE" ]]; then
    "$timeout_bin" -k 5 "$TIMEOUT" bash -c 'bash -c "$1"; printf "%s\n" "$?" > "$2"; exit 0' _ "$COMMAND" "$CENSOR_STATUS_FILE"
    return
  fi
  "$timeout_bin" -k 5 "$TIMEOUT" bash -c "$COMMAND"
}

run_with_timeout() {
  if command -v timeout >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    run_timed_command timeout
    return
  fi

  if command -v gtimeout >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    run_timed_command gtimeout
    return
  fi

  if resolve_python; then
    "${PYTHON_CMD[@]}" - "$TIMEOUT" "$COMMAND" "$CENSOR_STATUS_FILE" <<'PY'
import os
import signal
import subprocess
import sys

timeout_seconds = float(sys.argv[1])
command = sys.argv[2]
status_file = sys.argv[3]
proc = subprocess.Popen(["bash", "-c", command], start_new_session=True)

try:
    status = proc.wait(timeout=timeout_seconds)
    status = 128 - status if status < 0 else status
    if status_file:
        with open(status_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            handle.write(f"{status}\n")
        sys.exit(0)
    sys.exit(status)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
    try:
        os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
    except ProcessLookupError:
        pass
    try:
        proc.wait(timeout=5)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        try:
            os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        except ProcessLookupError:
            pass
        proc.wait()
    sys.exit(124)
PY
    return
  fi

  echo "Error: no timeout implementation available (tried timeout, gtimeout, python3, python, py -3)" >&2
  exit 1
}

# The owner must establish futility for every required objective before setting
# this bound. A command's own 124/125 exit is not a runner censor event.
CENSOR_AFTER="${SPEC_OPTIMIZE_CENSOR_AFTER:-}"
CENSOR_STATUS_FILE=""
if [[ -n "$CENSOR_AFTER" ]]; then
  if ! awk -v a="$CENSOR_AFTER" -v t="$TIMEOUT" 'BEGIN { exit !(a ~ /^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$/ && a+0 > 0 && a+0 < t+0) }'; then
    echo "Error: SPEC_OPTIMIZE_CENSOR_AFTER must be positive and below timeout_seconds" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  TIMEOUT="$CENSOR_AFTER"
  CENSOR_STATUS_FILE=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/spec-optimize-censor-XXXXXX")
  trap 'rm -f "$CENSOR_STATUS_FILE"' EXIT
fi

set +e
run_with_timeout
status=$?
set -e
if [[ -n "$CENSOR_STATUS_FILE" ]]; then
  if [[ -s "$CENSOR_STATUS_FILE" ]]; then
    status=$(<"$CENSOR_STATUS_FILE")
  elif [[ $status -eq 124 ]]; then
    echo "SPEC_OPTIMIZE_CENSORED: measurement censored after ${CENSOR_AFTER}s (noncompetitive bound)" >&2
    exit 125
  fi
fi
exit "$status"
